facts.fact: 十年前的六月，继母 Eloise 训斥 Billie 闭嘴去洗碗，饭没吃完就被赶去洗碗，父亲在旁沉默不帮腔。
facts.anchor: “Billie—just shut the fuck up. No one wants to hear you blab your mouth. Go start the dishes,”

facts.fact: Sean 发短信约 Billie 7:37pm 到高中见面；她谎称好友 Rosie 请她去帮忙练钢琴新歌才获准出门。
facts.anchor: Meet me at the high school. I have a fun idea. 7:37pm

facts.fact: 毕业仅一周后，Sean 把铁门上了挂锁的球场围栏爬了过去，带 Billie 翻进高中球场。
facts.anchor: You do realize we graduated a week ago, right?

facts.fact: Sean 在看台上正式向 Billie 告白，Billie 回应自己也很喜欢他。
Sean 坦白八月（仅两个月后）就要去德州参加 bootcamp；Billie 拒绝确立关系，Sean 说两年后就回 Lakewood 创业。
facts.anchor: He’s leaving for Texas to start bootcamp in August. In only two months.

facts.fact: Sean 脱下自己身上的灰色 Carhartt 卫衣让 Billie 穿上留作纪念。
facts.anchor: “You should keep it. Something you can remember me by.”

facts.fact: 赴 Jen 的派对前，继母 Eloise 骂只露一寸肚子的 Billie 穿得像 whore；车上 Sean 问起，她转述了这话。
facts.anchor: Not after Eloise said I looked like a whore and was asking for it.

facts.fact: 转折：派对上 Billie 第一次喝酒（两杯 vanilla vodka）后承认想把初夜给 Sean，Sean 拒绝当下吻她，但承诺将来有一天会成为恋人。
facts.anchor: “But I will one day. And one day we’ll be more too. I promise you that.”
